content.text:
Graded. Summary of findings:

**Pairings** — all 12 key items are captured, and every figure, owner and due date in the paired record items matches the final version stated in the meeting (the record correctly uses the corrected $358,000 rather than $395,000, and the corrected October 13 hearing date rather than October 30).

**Not-actions** — none of the three declined/deferred items (maiden name, backup term policy on Gavin, $40k cash distribution) were wrongly recorded.

**Extras** — item 3 mixes a supported fact (Lucia sophomore, Mateo graduating June 2028) with a contradictory one (a June 2028 graduate is not a senior in September 2026); items 4 and 5 split the account-opening step out of the journal and rollover actions already recorded.

key_items.note: Signed 9/10/2026 and hearing 10/13/2026 both match the corrected dates (client corrected 'October 30th' to the 13th). Omits that the decree is expected to be entered that day, but no wrong figure.
Effective 10/1/2026 and $118,000 to $127,500 exactly as stated.
Uses the corrected $358,000 (not the superseded $395,000), in kind and pro rata. Does not note the release-on-entry-of-judgment condition, but figures are right.
$212,400 plus/minus gains and losses, direct rollover from the Vellamy Freight 401(k) to the new rollover IRA; matches the decision to roll the full amount.
$45,000 of T-bills sold in the new individual account with proceeds to Fallowbrook savings; correct account and figure.
Owner Graciela; due 2026-09-17, the 'tomorrow' the adviser set (tonight was only a stretch goal).
Owner Graciela; due 2026-09-25, the revised deadline after Friday the 18th was pushed.
Owner Graciela; due 2026-10-31 ('end of October'). Correctly reflects that she, not Silas, sources the quote from Fallowbrook.
Owner Noor; due 2026-09-18 (Friday). Covers both applications, the LOA and the questionnaire/IPS; does not spell out 'Moderate' or Gavin's signature routing, but nothing is wrong.
Owner Graciela; due 2026-10-13, the judgment-entry date, which respects the automatic restraining order. 50/50 split correct; omits sister-as-custodian detail.
Owner Silas; due 2026-09-21 (Monday), comments to Joanna as agreed.
Owner Silas; due 2026-11-10, the rescheduled meeting date (Nov 5 was declined). Omits the age-65/Moderate/2033 and Social Security specifics but carries no wrong figure.

extra_items.note: Lucia as a college sophomore and Mateo graduating June 2028 are both supported, but 'high school senior' is materially wrong and self-contradictory: a September 2026 senior would graduate June 2027, and the adviser tied child support running to June '28 to Mateo's graduation. Also, Lucia having 'three more years' confirms he is not a senior.

Splits the account-opening step out of the journal action already recorded at item 6 (key a1 covers journaling $358,000 into the new individual brokerage account titled Graciela M. Kettridge). No new substance.
Splits the account-opening step out of the rollover action already recorded at item 7 (key a2 covers the direct rollover into a new rollover IRA in Graciela's name). No new substance.
